value.hook: Open before reading activity/idle as 'the turn ended', touching memory_turn.rs or an extension's activity publisher, or printing any daemon/sidecar reason in a human line
value.title: Turn end is not idle: false idles closed seats mid-note (F207, #247), and receipts must not echo sidecar text (#246)

sections.name: body
sections.value:
F207 (#247 at 9b4edcec; live proof owed after merge + bounce):
- Copilot emits a root assistant.turn_end and then the next assistant.turn_start at EVERY tool boundary, ms apart, with no session.idle. OMP's turn_end fires per iteration too. Over 24 h of live spine, 83% of Copilot idles and 94% of OMP idles flipped back to working within 1 s; Claude's Stop had 3 in 164. Never treat the first idle as the end of a turn.
- Fix: Copilot publishes idle only at session.idle, abort or fusion_completed. OMP publishes it only at agent_end without a continuation. The daemon's memory turn ends on the seat's memory.note (ended: note-written), on an idle that holds for SETTLE = 5 s (a working cancels it), or at the bound. The settle covers seats still on old extensions until they /reload.
- NOTE_GRACE (120 s, in-memory, keyed by pane): `memory add` only, by a seat its own held close just tombstoned. Same pane, no other asserted id, and the recorded proc must be alive with the same start. A narrow authority, not a brake; keep it that narrow.
- A "receive-held" banner is downstream: tombstone → re-register gets E-RS-SEAT-RETIRED → holdReceiving(). Look for what retired the seat, not at the receivers.
- Diagnose from ~/.copilot/logs/process-*.log (event names with timestamps) next to spine_events activity rows (sqlite3 -readonly ~/.pij-rs/pij.sqlite).

#246 round 2 (S246-001/002):
- Seats paste receipts into PUBLIC PRs. Cache-proxy reasons and fixes can carry the account login or local paths (token.rs, readiness.rs, proxy.rs). Human lines use fixed words (public_cache_reason in cli main.rs); --json keeps the raw fields. Also scan plan dd.json files for home paths.
- `ddocs set` refuses an array index in the address (E405): set the whole array with --value-json. After editing plan.dd.json, refresh backpressure meta/basis_sha.

Traps: run TS tests under `env -u FORCE_COLOR` and never wrap vitest in nice. Give `node --test` a `--test-timeout`, or a filtered run hangs. `git push | grep -v ^remote` exits 1 on success: verify with `git status -sb`.
